354:t_101:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Now that $$刹那$$ has awakened as an $$イノベイター$$, I want to know what that means...! As the $$イノベイド$$ who guides him!)

354:t_102:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we retake $$ヴェーダ$$, it'll be a huge boost for the battles ahead...!」

354:t_102:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We're making this mission a success, no matter what!」

354:t_103:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「You $$スフィア・リアクター$$s! The only fate waiting for you after turning down the Empire's offer is a miserable defeat!」

354:t_103:1.en:
$n
「Declaring our defeat on your own... The classic threat of a villain.」

354:t_103:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Oh! That's not a bad smile either, $n!」

354:t_103:3.en:
$n
「How about we call it the Dark Smile?」

354:t_103:4.en:
$$メール$$
「Your sense of naming is totally hopeless, huh.」

354:t_103:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「No time to be down, $n! Let's quickly take out $$ストラウス$$'s lackey!」

354:t_103:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Who are you calling a lackey?! I am... I am!!」

354:t_104:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「This is for $$ラース・バビロン$$! Take it all!」

354:t_104:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「I can tell! You're burning up under that armor too!」

354:t_104:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Here I come! I'll blast you and that armor away!」

354:t_105:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I never thought I'd be fighting in an EVA in this world again...)

354:t_105:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
(That $$綾波$$ isn't the $$綾波$$ I know...)

354:t_105:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I don't get it... I don't understand anything at all...)

354:t_105:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「You're going to be all right.」

354:t_105:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
($$カヲル$$ is here... As long as $$カヲル$$ is with me, I can... fight...)

354:t_105:9.en:
$$シンジ$$
(All I can do now is fight... Together with $$カヲル$$ and the $$綾波$$ I don't know...)

354:t_106:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「This isn't the world we came from, you know. Isn't it kind of tacky to drag our old relationships into it?」

354:t_106:3.en:
$$マリ$$
「Then what was that burning stare you were giving Puppy, nya~?」

354:t_106:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well, fine by me. Looks like we'll be spending a while with that side anyway.」

354:t_106:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「Stop! If we can't get through this, there's nothing beyond it either.」

354:t_106:8.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Four-Eyes! I don't need you to tell me...!」

354:t_106:9.en:
$$マリ$$
「Yeah, yeah. Aim that anger at the enemy, $$姫$$.」
